learning_outcomes.text: Produce professional texts and presentations using appropriate office tools.
Know and apply advanced spreadsheet functions and techniques, including macro creation, to perform calculations and data analysis in the field of engineering.
Knowledge and mastery of basic user computer concepts, efficiently using the most common office applications.
Ability to make efficient use of spreadsheet software to perform calculations and data analysis in the field of engineering.

syllabus_topics: Use of MS Power Point: Basic concepts, use and template creation
Use of MS Power Point: Visual effects
Use of MS Power Point: Professional visualization
Use of MS Power Point: Shortcuts
Use of MS Word: Basic concepts, covers, tables, etc.
Use of MS Word: References, bibliographies, templates, etc.
Use MS Excel: Basic concepts, templates, visualization
Use MS Excel: Use of formulas
Use MS Excel: Introduction to macros
teaching_methods: Personal study, report writing, practical assignments, etc. as independent work by the student or group of students
assessment_rules: Evaluation consists of three exams (PowerPoint 20%, Word 10%, Excel 20%) and practical exercises submitted after each session, which account for the remaining 50% of the grade. Each exam involves completing a practical exercise.
